============================================================================
OmniBuf-PHP Benchmark Suite (PHP 8.6.0 / darwin-arm64 / Apple M1 Pro)
Workload: 11-field PeerUpdate (365B OmniBuf, 341B Protobuf) + >16 KiB stress cases
============================================================================

### 1. Full Message Encode Speed

| Codec / Operation | Latency (ns/op) | Throughput (ops/sec) | Wire Size (B) | vs Baseline |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| OmniBuf (ext-omnibuf) | 317 ns | 3,155,581 | 365 | 1.00x (baseline) |
| OmniBuf (Generated) | 4,584 ns | 218,172 | 365 | 14.46x slower |
| OmniBuf (Attributes) | 11,416 ns | 87,597 | 365 | 36.01x slower |
| google/protobuf (C ext) | 420 ns | 2,380,831 | 341 | 1.32x slower |
| google/protobuf (pure PHP) | 86,075 ns | 11,618 | 341 | 271.53x slower |
| json_encode (stdlib) | 1,412 ns | 708,176 | 803 | 4.45x slower |

### 2. Full Message Decode Speed

| Codec / Operation | Latency (ns/op) | Throughput (ops/sec) | vs Baseline |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| OmniBuf (ext-omnibuf) | 955 ns | 1,047,568 | 1.00x (baseline) |
| OmniBuf (Generated) | 15,899 ns | 62,896 | 16.65x slower |
| OmniBuf (Attributes) | 25,670 ns | 38,956 | 26.88x slower |
| google/protobuf (C ext) | 3,678 ns | 271,869 | 3.85x slower |
| google/protobuf (pure PHP) | 49,895 ns | 20,042 | 52.25x slower |
| json_decode (stdlib) | 4,214 ns | 237,294 | 4.41x slower |

### 5. Large Embedded Message Encode

| Codec / Operation | Latency (ns/op) | Throughput (ops/sec) | Wire Size (B) | vs Baseline |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| OmniBuf (ext-omnibuf) | 949 ns | 1,053,903 | 39255 | 1.00x (baseline) |
| OmniBuf (Generated) | 8,738 ns | 114,437 | 39255 | 9.21x slower |
| OmniBuf (Attributes) | 18,372 ns | 54,431 | 39255 | 19.36x slower |
| google/protobuf (C ext) | 2,195 ns | 455,495 | 39227 | 2.31x slower |
| google/protobuf (pure PHP) | 1,160,962 ns | 861 | 39227 | 1223.35x slower |
| json_encode (stdlib) | 23,540 ns | 42,480 | 39681 | 24.81x slower |

### 6. Embedded Message Growth

| Codec / Operation | Latency (ns/op) | Throughput (ops/sec) | vs Baseline |
|---|---:|---:|---:|

| OmniBuf (Generated) | 10,390 ns | 96,247 | 4.76x slower |
